verdicts.reason: A: the top text block is jammed together, and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has dropped below the URL, so the reading order is wrong. The three tag pills are split up, with 'ALL AGES' alone above the ticket and 'FREE ENTRY' and 'TASTINGS' stacked under the CTA. Those pills are styled almost exactly like 'RSVP Free', so the CTA is buried, and the partner mark is clipped at the left edge. B: it has the same cramped top stack and the same misplaced 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS', and the logo is pushed hard against the right edge. Still, the RSVP button sits right under the event details and clearly outranks the three pills, which are grouped together. Its big partner-mark box is clipped and heavy, but B's hierarchy and grouping are slightly better.
